nowPlaying.label: Now Playing
nowPlaying.emptyBody: Open audio files, drop them here, or paste a link.

errors.mpvMissingHint: Install mpv, or run npm run fetch-sidecars when building from source.

settings.title: Settings
settings.refractionUnsupported: This engine can't render refraction, so glass uses blur and highlights instead.
settings.artworkAccentHint: Tints the interface with the cover of the playing track. Some themes keep their own accent.
settings.powerSavingHint: Turns off blur, refraction and animations.
settings.liquidGlassUnsupported: Liquid Glass needs macOS 26 or later.
settings.liquidGlassFallback: Liquid Glass isn't available here, so vibrancy is used.

library.title: Library
library.removeFolderConfirm: Remove “{{path}}” from the library? The files stay on disk, but play counts and playlist entries of its songs are lost.
library.noFolders: No folders yet. Add the folder where you keep your music.
library.watchHint: Folders are watched: new, changed and deleted files show up by themselves.
library.insideFolder: This folder is already in your library as part of “{{folder}}”.
library.addOpenedFiles: Add opened files to the library
library.addOpenedFilesHint: Files you open or drop join the library as single songs, with favorites, history and playlists. A folder added later takes them in.

downloads.title: Downloads

formatHints.original: The site’s own audio (usually Opus or M4A), not re-encoded: the best quality.
formatHints.flac: Converted to FLAC: lossless container, but no better than the original.

downloads.templateHint: Use {artist}, {title}, {album} and {year}; a missing value takes its separator with it.
downloads.ytDlpVersion: Version {{version}}. Sites change often; update when links stop working.
downloads.ytDlpMissing: yt-dlp wasn’t found, so links can’t be played or downloaded.
downloads.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg wasn’t found: downloads need it.

library.emptyBody: Add a folder with music. Vitra keeps it up to date as files change.
library.searchHint: Search by title, artist, album or lyrics.
library.noFavoritesBody: Mark songs with ♥ to collect them here.
library.emptyPlaylistBody: Add songs from their context menu.
library.deletePlaylistConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? The songs stay in your library.
library.removeOneConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the library? The file stays on disk, but its play count and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeManyConfirm_one: Remove {{count}} song from the library? The files stay on disk, but play counts and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeManyConfirm_other: Remove {{count}} songs from the library? The files stay on disk, but play counts and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeLinkConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the library? Its play count and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeLinksConfirm_one: Remove {{count}} link from the library? Play counts and playlist entries are lost.
library.removeLinksConfirm_other: Remove {{count}} links from the library? Play counts and playlist entries are lost.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyBody: Play an album or a playlist, or add songs with Play Next.

tags.title: Edit Tags
tags.notWritable: Tags of this file format can't be edited.
tags.yearInvalid: Enter a year such as 1999, or leave it empty.

links.title: Open Link
links.placeholder: Paste a link to a song, playlist or radio stream
links.hint: YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, links to audio files and internet radio (.m3u, .pls, streams). You can also paste a link anywhere in the window.
links.importHint: Playing or importing adds the playlist to the sidebar; its songs fill in as their details arrive.

errors.invalid: That doesn’t look like a web link.
errors.ytDlpMissing: yt-dlp wasn’t found. It plays links from YouTube, SoundCloud and other sites.
errors.timeout: The site didn’t answer in time. Try again later.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.emptyBody: Download songs from links with Download in their menu or in the link dialog.
